title: Text animations
summary: Bold kinetic typography in the theme’s look: heavy techno caps that slam, stretch and split on the dark grid, glowing targeting rings, notched plates, marquee strips, bracketed insets and mono readouts.
usage: Title cards fill the frame (any shape from square to 9:16): use one as a shot's "background" (a candidate may then omit "visual") or as its "visual", e.g. {"background": {"piece": "text/headline-slam", "props": {"lines": ["YOUR", "WORDS"], "accent": "cyan"}}}, or as a footage "cutaway". Overlays are see-through, in 1080×1920 frame pixels: {"piece": "text/keyword-slam", "start": 1.2, "end": 3.4, "props": {"word": "FOCUS", "y": 330}}. Every word and position is a prop; "accent" (cyan, magenta or amber) picks the colour that leads. Kit: library/themes/futuristic/text/kit.js. Files: library/themes/futuristic/text/pieces/.

items.name: Headline slam
items.description: A headline slams onto the grid letter by letter with its colours split, with smearing targeting rings, spinning marks and readouts top and bottom.

items.name: Split stack
items.description: Two stacked words fly in from opposite sides, stretched by their speed, with a bracketed picture inset popping between them.

items.name: Marquee wall
items.description: A full frame of marquee strips scrolling in alternating directions, every other copy mirrored; plain, ruled and filled rows open one after another.

items.name: Ring Statement
items.description: A wrapped statement rises word by word over large drifting targeting rings that leave smears behind them.

items.name: Big number
items.description: One huge number or year: each digit rolls like an odometer and lands with a bounce, then a label wipes in on a filled plate.

items.name: Quote card
items.description: A quote in heavy caps; words slide in leaning into the move, then a filled bar swipes behind the last line.

items.name: Agenda
items.description: A numbered list: rows fly in from the right and a filled bar steps down the list one row at a time.

items.name: Versus
items.description: Two words on two tinted panels that slide in and meet on a slanted seam; a hex badge punches in and knocks both back.

items.name: Chapter opener
items.description: A giant outlined number flies in and fills with light, the title rises beneath it and a bracket frame snaps around the card.

items.name: Countdown
items.description: Numbers slam in one per beat, each led by the next accent with a scan line and a ring running down, ending on a GO word with a burst.

items.name: End card
items.description: Call to action: headline rises from the floor, a filled button plate stretches open with a nudging arrow, the handle types on, a marquee runs below.

items.name: Keyword slam
items.description: One keyword slams letter by letter across a tilted notched plate at the top or bottom of the frame.

items.name: Highlight swipe
items.description: A short phrase on a dark plate; a filled bar swipes in behind the marked words and flips them to dark.

items.name: Lower third
items.description: Name plate: a filled notched plate whips in, the name rises out of it letter by letter, a role plate slides out underneath.

items.name: Side text
items.description: Vertical text on a dark plate running up one edge of the frame, with a thin strip of readout text scrolling beside it.

items.name: Marquee band
items.description: A scrolling marquee band with mirrored copies and a thin counter-scrolling readout strip; springs open, folds shut.

items.name: Corner labels
items.description: Labels on filled chips pinned in the four corners with bracket marks, a reticle and a badge; the middle stays clear.

items.name: Picture frame
items.description: A bracketed picture-in-picture frame that punches in, with a label tab, a smearing targeting ring and a spinning reticle.

items.name: Sticker
items.description: A notched round seal that pops on with a spin, with a word in the middle and readout text turning around the edge.
